# aloha2sim

Project page for **aloha2sim**, a MuJoCo twin of an ALOHA-2 workcell running the
hidden-property pick-and-place task.

**→ https://theotaoliu.github.io/aloha2sim-page/**

The page carries the task description, a plan view of the table layout and a clip of the
scripted policy in MuJoCo's interactive viewer.

## Do not edit this repository by hand

It is generated. `index.html`, `media/` and `.nojekyll` are mirrored here from the `docs/`
directory of the private `aloha2sim` repository by its `docs/deploy.sh`, and the next sync
overwrites whatever is edited here. Change the page there instead.

GitHub Pages publishes this repository through the workflow in `.github/workflows/pages.yml`
(Settings → Pages → Source: "GitHub Actions"), so the site is the repository root.
